title: Marvel plans a Patrick Stewart tribute in Avengers: Doomsday
body_md:
Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige has discussed plans to honor Patrick Stewart in Avengers: Doomsday, according to two reports included in the November 25 historical news feed. Both describe the forthcoming production as the actor's final screen appearance and revisit his experience on the set of the Marvel ensemble.

Stewart returns as Professor Charles Xavier, the character whose relationship with successive generations of X-Men audiences has extended across numerous films. The reports state that he was initially offered appearances in both Doomsday and Avengers: Secret Wars, but chose to participate only in the first production.

Feige recalled Stewart addressing the crew on his final shooting day. Although the people working on the film could not know with certainty that it would be his last appearance on a set, the actor's remarks suggested that he had considered the possibility himself.

Co-director Anthony Russo described the experience as particularly emotional because Stewart faced significant health difficulties while working. The filmmaker emphasized the effort involved in delivering a performance and participating in a collaborative production under those circumstances.

Joe Russo also discussed Xavier's narrative importance. The character serves in part as the film's moral conscience, and the director highlighted a scene involving Stewart and Ian McKellen that addresses forgiveness.

For longtime viewers, the pairing carries considerable history. Stewart's Xavier and McKellen's Magneto have represented opposing ideas about coexistence and conflict throughout the X-Men franchise. Their personal connection has frequently provided an emotional dimension to stories otherwise dominated by large-scale confrontations.

The two available reports disagree on the precise October date of Stewart's reported death. Accordingly, this account does not present either day as independently established. The shared information is that the reports describe his passing in October 2026.

Feige indicated that the studio was considering how to pay tribute to its colleague. No specific format for the tribute has been confirmed in the material available here. It would therefore be premature to describe an additional scene, dedication or other particular element as an established part of the finished film.

Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to open on December 18, 2026. Anthony and Joe Russo's return to the franchise places characters from different generations of Marvel films within the same production.

For fans of Stewart's portrayal, the significance of that return extends beyond the mechanics of a superhero crossover. The character's long-standing association with questions of responsibility, compassion and reconciliation makes his final reported appearance an especially meaningful component of the film's release.
